title: Mamba selective-parameter Mirror basis
hypothesis: A small per-token coordinate m(x) over a shared basis for Mamba-style input-selective B/C/Delta generators can preserve sequence outputs with lower serialized payload and generator compute than independent native projections, and must beat a matched native joint-basis projection to count as Mirror-specific.
physical_object: One shared input projection basis feeding selective B, C, and Delta generators in a diagonal state-space layer
mirror_coordinate: Per-token m(x)=Vx, with B/C/Delta coefficients decoded from separate output bases U_B/U_C/U_Delta
logical_multiplicity: Content-dependent selective state dynamics across input sequences

task.metric: Held-out sequence output NRMSE, actual serialized inference payload bytes, generator MAC proxy and isolated serialization wall time

development.selection_metric: Quality-storage-compute frontier over rank and residual; no rank may be selected from fresh results

controls: Full native input-selective diagonal SSM with independent B/C/Delta linear projections
Native independent rank-k factorization of each B/C/Delta projection
Native joint shared-input-basis projection for B/C/Delta
Mirror per-token shared coordinate m(x) with the same joint basis and decoders

paid_objects: shared input basis or independent factors

compute: Input projection/generator MAC proxy per token
success_gate: At residual 0 and rank <=4, Mirror output NRMSE <=0.02 and complete payload <=60% of full native projections; it must strictly improve payload or quality over both native independent low-rank and native joint-basis controls without >10% generator-MAC overhead.
failure_gate: Quality/storage gate misses, or Mirror state/outputs exactly alias the native joint shared-basis method without a strict quality/byte/compute gain. Development exact alias permits fresh to remain sealed.
boundaries: Synthetic diagonal SSM only; not a Mamba implementation or language-model reproduction
Teacher selectivity is input-dependent for all three generated parameters B, C, and Delta
Rank and residual sweep are fixed before development
All dynamics, input basis, decoders, and metadata are serialized and charged
No fresh result may alter rank or factorization
